opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members holding Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) category before submitting; must hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access. Round 1 closed 15 June 2026; Round 2 opens 12 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026. Prioritises projects engaging under-represented audiences, developing members' engagement skills, and supporting positive social outcomes.
